questions.stem_text: What are some reasons why there has been a relativeshift fromfarming?

options.A: The invention of automated systems that have made traditional farming obsolete
options.B: Emergence of widespread diseases that make farming untenable
options.C: Shift in consumer preferences towards synthetic foods
options.D: A global decrease in the demand for agricultural products
options.E: People seek the higher incomes of the city, shorter hours, and better social life in town

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: E - People seek the higher incomes of the city, shorter hours, and better social life in town

questions.stem_text: What is the main objective of modem central banking? Explain.

options.A: Formulation of policies that influence the monetary base.
options.D: Managing government spending and fiscal policy
options.E: Overseeing the stock market and financial investments

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Formulation of policies that influence the monetary base.

questions.stem_text: If the demand for dollars rises while the supply of dollars falls then the

options.B: dollar will lose its status as a global currency.
options.D: exchange rates will rise but the value of the dollar will not be affected.
options.E: value of other currencies will fall.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - dollar will remain stable.
